components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary-bg); color: var(--primary-text); height: var(--component-control-height); padding: 0 var(--component-control-padding-inline); border: 1px solid var(--primary-bg); border-radius: var(--component-control-radius); font: var(--font-weight-semibold) var(--font-size-md)/var(--line-height-ui) var(--font-family-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.12s ease, border-color 0.12s ease, transform 0.08s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: var(--component-focus-ring) solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-2), transparent 35%); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Accent Button
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { background: var(--accent-2); color: var(--accent-2-text); height: var(--component-control-height); padding: 0 var(--component-control-padding-inline); border: 1px solid var(--accent-2); border-radius: var(--component-control-radius); font: var(--font-weight-semibold) var(--font-size-md)/var(--line-height-ui) var(--font-family-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.12s ease, border-color 0.12s ease, transform 0.08s ease; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: var(--component-focus-ring) solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-2), transparent 35%); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-accent:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Brand Title
components.description: The shared title style used by brand and modal headings.
components.css: .ds-title { color: var(--text); font: var(--font-weight-bold) var(--font-size-lg)/var(--line-height-ui) var(--font-family-sans); }

components.name: Modal Title
components.description: The same title contract applied inside the information modal.
components.css: .ds-modal-title { margin: 0; color: var(--text); font: var(--font-weight-bold) var(--font-size-lg)/var(--line-height-ui) var(--font-family-sans); }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-input { height: var(--component-control-height); width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding: 0 var(--component-input-padding-inline); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--component-input-radius); background: var(--control-bg); color: var(--text); font: var(--font-weight-regular) var(--font-size-md)/var(--line-height-ui) var(--font-family-sans); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: var(--component-focus-ring) solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent-2), transparent 35%); outline-offset: 2px; border-color: var(--accent-2); }

components.name: Surface Panel
components.description: Bordered panel surface for inspectors and menus.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: var(--space-4); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--component-surface-radius); background: var(--panel); color: var(--text); } .ds-panel p { margin: var(--space-1) 0 0; color: var(--muted); font: var(--font-weight-regular) var(--font-size-sm)/var(--line-height-body) var(--font-family-sans); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 22px; padding: 3px var(--space-3); border-radius: var(--component-chip-radius); background: var(--chip-bg); color: var(--muted); font: var(--font-weight-strong) var(--font-size-xs)/var(--line-height-ui) var(--font-family-sans); }

components.name: Quad Handle
components.description: Circular touch target for direct corner correction.
components.css: .ds-handle { width: 48px; height: 48px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: var(--radius-circle); background: transparent; cursor: grab; touch-action: none; } .ds-handle:hover, .ds-handle.is-active { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--handle), transparent 72%); } .ds-handle:focus-visible { outline: var(--component-focus-ring) solid var(--accent-2); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Slides Thief is a focused browser-local workbench for correcting photographed slides and documents. Its compact system uses slate surfaces, teal precision accents, terracotta identity, and a yellow direct-manipulation handle.
keyCharacteristics: Slate Ink & Teal Precision Tonal Palette
Tokenized Density Across Geometry and Type

rules.name: The Single Accent Rule
rules.body: Terracotta is reserved for identity and attention. Functional quad overlays and confirmations use Teal Precision.

dos: Do use primitive, semantic, and component CSS variables for recurring geometry and visual roles.
Do keep the 1040px tablet and 834px mobile thresholds synchronized with their named breakpoint tokens.
Do preserve browser-local processing and keyboard/ARIA behavior.
donts: Don't introduce a new radius, control height, or spacing value when an existing token matches the intent.
Don't use terracotta for ordinary canvas geometry.
Don't execute image processing on the main UI thread.
